column1: # The VCU close request is injected automatically by the simulator.  The bus
# starts tied to the pack (bus_mv = 0) so the precharge completes quickly and
# the state machine settles in CHARGE.
# Phase 2 (20-80 s)   : cell 5 (index 4) rises to 3480 mV        -> balance
# Phase 3 (80-140 s)  : cell 5 relaxes to 3460 mV                -> balance
# Phase 4 (140-200 s) : cell 5 falls to 3452 mV (delta 2 mV)     -> stop
